    Interface Handler<Opts>

    A unit of interaction (pan, zoom, selection…). Every interaction on the map is one of these. Mirrors MapLibre's handler model.

    Example

    Runnable example association: geoparquet-viewer.

    interface Handler<Opts = unknown> {
        name: string;
        disable(): void;
        enable(): void;
        getCursor?(): string | null;
        getOptions(): Readonly<Opts>;
        handlePointer(ev: NormalizedPointerEvent): HandlerResult;
        isEnabled(): boolean;
        setOptions(opts: Partial<Opts>): void;
    }

    OptionalgetCursor

    • getCursor?(): string | null

      CSS cursor this handler wants for its CURRENT state, or null = no opinion (HandlerManager falls through to lower-priority handlers, then the page/CSS default). Optional — absent ⇒ no opinion. An empty string '' is treated the same as null (no opinion); to clear to the page/CSS default, simply have no enabled handler with an opinion (HandlerManager writes '' itself in that case).

      Returns string | null
